thread.title: Qorvo stock rises after KeyBanc upgrades to overweight - MarketWatch

author: Emily Bary
title: Qorvo stock rises after KeyBanc upgrades to overweight - MarketWatch
text: Qorvo Inc. QRVO, -3.32% shares are up 2.3% in premarket trading after KeyBanc Capital Markets analyst John Vinh upgraded the stock to overweight from sector weight. "We believe the healthy handset demand environment for China and Apple AAPL, -1.74% sets up well for the stock to outperform in the second half in conjunction with share gains in China and content gains in the new iPhone," Vinh wrote. His price target of $95 reflects expectations for market-share gains as well as interest-expense savings stemming from the company's debt pay down. Qorvo shares are up 19% over the past 12 months, while the S&P 500 SPX, -0.49% has gained 12%.
